notes.title: Update 0.0.4-EA Memories and Videos
notes.notes:
Greetings, Citizens from the Future!

We’re thrilled to roll out Nexus Wars Update 0.0.4-EA, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your galactic conquests! Here’s what’s new in this patch:

New Features
Memories System:
Relive your epic runs! Players can now access and read details of their previous runs, allowing you to reflect on past strategies and triumphs.

Memories will serve a path the new puzzle, that ultimately will lead your character to a discovery and a unique story line

Faction Video Introductions:
Dive deeper into the lore of Nexus Wars! Each faction now has its own cinematic video introduction, showcasing their unique style and story. Check them out in-game!

[previewyoutube=wnCDWJQC5ek;full][/previewyoutube]

Improvements
UI Overhaul:
We’ve revamped the user interface for a smoother, more intuitive experience. Navigate menus with ease and focus on dominating the battlefield.

Bug Fixes
Minor bug fixes and performance optimizations to ensure a more stable experience.

We’d love to hear your feedback on these changes, so drop by our Steam Discussions, join the community on Twitter @NexusWars_ or jump into Discord

Thank you for your continued support as we shape Nexus Wars together in Early Access. Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll see you on the battlefield!
— The Nexus Wars Team
